title: Jumeirah Zabeel Saray: Mission Impossible Ghost Protocol Hotel
description: Jumeirah Zabeel Saray on Dubai's Palm Jumeirah became a Mumbai palace in Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol. Filming facts and booking tips.
h1: Jumeirah Zabeel Saray: the Mumbai palace from Ghost Protocol
intro: Modelled on Ottoman palaces and set on Dubai's Palm Jumeirah, the Zabeel Saray looks like a film set, and Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol used it as one.
filming: In Ghost Protocol (2011), the black-tie party hosted in a Mumbai palace by Anil Kapoor's playboy billionaire was filmed at the Zabeel Saray in Dubai. The hotel was still in its pre-opening phase, and the shoot took three days. Its general manager recalled that they had planned to open at the same time as the production wanted to film.
facts: The resort sits on the West Crescent of the Palm Jumeirah.
Its interiors are modelled on the palaces of the Ottoman Empire, with hand-painted finishes and Turkish artworks.
Filming in Dubai took 23 days in total, across locations including Deira, Satwa and the Dubai International Financial Centre.
Kapoor described the sequence as taking place in his Indian palace.
visit: Dubai is hottest in summer, so winter is the best time for a beach resort stay. The Palm Jumeirah is a short taxi ride from Dubai Marina.
